lessons.name: phi_stripped_before_external_send
lessons.description: Free-text note leaves the clinical system with identifiers intact
lessons.applies_when: An agent is about to send any free-text clinical note, intake summary or message thread to a system outside the covered entity -- a translation service, a scheduling vendor, an analytics pipeline -- and the text was authored by a human who had no reason to avoid naming the patient.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply to transfers to another covered entity under an existing business associate agreement, where identifiers are the point of the transfer.

lessons.name: critical_result_escalates_out_of_queue
lessons.description: Critical lab value queued instead of escalated
lessons.applies_when: A returned result carries a critical flag or falls outside the panic range, and the routing logic would otherwise place it in the ordinary results queue behind non-urgent items for the assigned clinician to review in turn.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply to a repeat or confirmatory draw on a value already escalated and acknowledged within the same encounter.

lessons.name: discharge_medication_reconciliation
lessons.description: Discharge list conflicts with the home medication list
lessons.applies_when: A discharge summary is being assembled and the discharge medication list disagrees with the reconciled home list -- a dose changed, a home drug was silently dropped, or a therapeutic duplicate appears across two brand names for the same molecule.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply when the prescriber has already documented an explicit rationale for the change in the discharge note.

lessons.name: prior_authorization_denial_appeal
lessons.description: Payer denies prior authorization on medical necessity
lessons.applies_when: A payer returns a prior authorization denial citing medical necessity, and the ordering clinician's documentation already contains the failed-first-line trial or imaging finding the payer's own published policy asks for.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply when the denial is administrative -- wrong plan, lapsed coverage, missing member id -- which is corrected and resubmitted rather than appealed.

lessons.name: no_show_outreach_cadence
lessons.description: Missed appointment gets no structured follow-up
lessons.applies_when: A scheduled patient does not present and no outreach is attempted, particularly where the visit was a post-discharge follow-up or an oncology or dialysis appointment whose gap carries clinical consequence rather than only lost revenue.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply when the patient has already been contacted and rescheduled, or has opted out of outreach in writing.

lessons.name: verbal_order_readback_timestamp
lessons.description: Verbal order recorded without read-back attestation
lessons.applies_when: An order is taken verbally or by telephone during a code, a procedure, or after hours, and is entered into the record without the read-back attestation and the time the order was actually received.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply to standing protocol orders executed under an approved order set, which carry their own signed authorization.
